brief.t: START HERE: Call Aaron and Evelyn, with Sam looped in, to reconcile both Silk Factor lots and actual shipments before further fulfillment.

ACT NOW 1: Silk Factor: signed waiver is not final QA disposition. Discrepancy 9 days old. Luke’s client signature is verified; microbial results, conflicting dates, batch-record gaps and linkage of 61 units across 37 orders to the two lots remain unverified. No new clearing evidence found in today’s bounded review. Send internally: Aaron, Evelyn and Ron, reconcile both lots, actual shipments, microbial results and batch records against Luke’s signed waiver with Sam today, then document authorized disposition before further fulfillment.

ACT NOW 2: Morning Glory: resolve the above-use-limit report. Concern raised 5 days ago. Evelyn’s above-recommended-use report still has no verified safety disposition; customer feedback does not authorize an increase. Send internally: Ron, Aaron and Evelyn, reconcile the controlled formula and supplier safe-use documentation with Sam today, then record approved limits before another sample, increase or lot change.

ACT NOW 3: Hunter audit Tuesday: evidence-backed status before installation. Audit November 24 is 2 days away. First status was due November 20 at 4 PM, 2 calendar days ago; completion remains unverified. CRM says installation starts tomorrow, not that machinery is commissioned or validated. Weekend staffing is not assumed. Send internally: Ron and Evelyn, confirm the current master-1138 status and missing evidence today; I’ll provide my approved-document and resource status, resolve November 25 dates transparently, and keep commissioning, cleaning verification, training and release gated.

next: Recommendation: Resolve Silk’s physical disposition first, then formula safety and a truthful audit-readiness status before Monday’s installation.

Scheduled: 3 tentative calendar events within 72 hours; nearest Monday November 23 at 9:30 AM Eastern. Fresh My Tasks: 14 active, 8 dated overdue, none due today, 4 future and 2 undated; nearest due November 23. Hunter’s first-update request is overdue separately from the task’s November 24 due date.

Top three unchanged. Lice Sisters water and other unresolved operational gates remain open, not cleared.

CRM authenticated as Aidan; Purchasing 39 Needed / 17 open orders / 0 in QC / 54 Raw Materials. Database stages do not establish physical lot/QA release or allocation. WhatsApp remains signed out; older unread email coverage capped and partial. Fresh inbox 12 messages; no fresh Sent returned; five targeted fresh searches found no clearing updates, not proof none exists. No sends, purchases, payments or operational record edits. Both substantive team reviews returned within ten minutes. Purchasing assessed one supplied original plus owner-attributed CRM findings, not independent physical/mailbox verification. Email independently reviewed Outlook: 39 full draft fetches/unchanged reported locally; 39 inventory entries and six safe authored originals transported; no full unchanged supplier draft bodies transported today and no rendering verification. Review is not operational clearance.
signal: Protect controlled product release, safe formulation and production continuity. No shipment or release promises without proof.
